transcript.statement: Safety is paramount in our ATM system to protect users from financial loss and ensure reliability in transactions. The requirement SAF-01 ensures no account has a negative balance, which protects users from overdraft fees. SAF-02 mandates automatic fund withdrawal from savings to maintain balance integrity. SAF-03 ensures users are informed and transactions are terminated if funds are insufficient, preventing unexpected financial issues. SAF-04 mandates logging for accountability. SAF-05 secures user authentication. SAF-06 allows for safe degradation during maintenance, and SAF-07 provides a clear account summary for user trust and understanding.

transcript.statement: Performance efficiency is critical for user satisfaction in our ATM system. Requirement EFF-01 ensures quick transaction processing within 3 seconds, enhancing user responsiveness. EFF-02 guarantees a minimum throughput of 100 transactions per minute for operational efficiency. EFF-03 focuses on optimizing data retrieval to reduce latency, which is essential for accessing transaction history swiftly. EFF-06 provides immediate feedback on withdrawal requests exceeding available balances, preventing user frustration. Lastly, EFF-07 incorporates load balancing, crucial for managing transaction requests effectively.

transcript.statement: Sustainability is crucial for our ATM system to minimize environmental impact and promote energy efficiency. requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance.
The system shall automatically withdraw funds from the related savings account after confirming sufficient balances.
The system shall inform the user immediately if a transaction cannot be completed due to insufficient funds.
The system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The system shall provide a mechanism for safe degradation by allowing limited withdrawals during system maintenance.
The system shall provide users with a clear summary of account status after each transaction.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds to ensure user responsiveness.
The system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.
The ATM application shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing.
The ATM system shall provide a carbon footprint report for each transaction executed integrated into transaction logs.
The ATM system shall utilize energy-efficient hardware components to operate.
The ATM system shall ensure user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.

These requirements were synthesized into F-05 for secure PIN verification.
The proposal to allow limited withdrawals during maintenance was retained.
The importance of clear account summaries was retained.
